info.name: Mend Access Management Access Management - Organizations API

items.docs: Returns a list of all organizations where the current user is a member.

params.name: orgToken
params.description: org UUID (by running Entities - Organization > Get User Organizations) or API Key (from the Mend SCA App: **Integrate** tab > **API Key**).

params.name: otherOrgToken
params.description: org UUID (by running Entities - Organization > Get User Organizations) or API Key (from the Mend SCA App: **Integrate** tab > **API Key**).

items.docs: You can access a different organization by asking for a new JWT token for the new org. The previous JWT is still valid for the previous org until it expires. All JWT tokens are valid for 10 minutes.
